Post 1
📈 ASX 200 crossed above its 20-day MA Friday, closing at 8,716.60 (+0.64%). Tech and discretionary led. With the index virtually flat year-to-date, this breakout matters. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 IT (+2.23%) and Consumer Discretionary (+2.16%) drove Friday's gains. A-REITs added +1.88%. On the other side, Materials (-0.03%) and Telcos (-0.57%) dragged. Risk-on rotation, not a broad rally. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
🔻 WBT fell 11.11% to AUD 2.800 — worst in the index. Uranium names followed: DYL -7.11%, SLX -5.43%. Nuclear enthusiasm is cooling fast while the rest of the market rips. #ASX #uranium

Post 4
🪙 Gold hit AUD 6,036.60/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6983. Silver at AUD 86.67/oz. A softer Aussie dollar is amplifying metals prices for local holders. #gold #silver #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX is flat year-to-date despite Friday's pop to 8,716.60. The 20-day MA cross is the line in the sand. Does it hold next week or fade? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz
